name: Maps
description: A single-file H5 stock navigation app. A journey has no fixed length: each route has a free-flowing time and a sensitivity to traffic, and the traffic multiplier is looked up by the hour you set off in — so the same motorway is 24 minutes at eleven and 52 at eight, and which of the three roads is quickest changes with the clock. At 08:00 the ring road, eleven kilometres longer than anything else, is the fastest way there; by mid-morning it is the slowest. That makes «leave by» a search rather than a subtraction, because the journey time you would subtract is the one for the hour you have not chosen yet. Four modes, a bus with a twelve-minute headway that traffic cannot touch, tolls, fuel and banded parking. 4 screens, 6 routes, a generated map.

finish.answer: final answer for question tasks; optional for action tasks

observation.text: engine.a11y(state) — every route prints its distance, free-flowing time, the multiplier in force and the resulting arrival; the departure strip prints the best journey and arrival for each ten-minute slot, flagging the ones that miss.
observation.pixels: 390x844 screenshot (browser backend); __ENV__.bounds() maps every test-id to a pixel box
observation.state: engine.snapshot(state) — canonical state plus per-route times, arrivals and costs. For the verifier only.

world.times: journey = free-flowing minutes × the multiplier for the departure hour, rounded up
world.routes: A38 22.4 km / 24 min / high sensitivity / £25 toll; through town 14.1 km / 27 min / very high / no toll; ring road 31.8 km / 33 min / low / £12 toll
world.flip: at 08:00 the ring road wins 47 to 52 to 67; at 09:00 the motorway wins 42 to 43 to 52; at 11:00 it is 28 to 32 to 35
world.leave_by: arriving by 09:00 means leaving at 08:10 on the ring road; arriving by 08:30 means leaving at 07:50 on the motorway, not 07:43
world.transit: bus 41 minutes plus the wait for a :04 departure every 12 minutes; unaffected by traffic
world.costs: fuel 60p/km, parking £1.80 an hour after a free first half hour, bus £6, bike hire £3, walking free
